name: HIVV — The People's Distributed AI Network
description: A distributed AI network: a hive of volunteer machines and peer hives that answers questions, runs tools, and writes code. Policy-gated by humans (YES / MAYBE / NO).

extensions.description: Deeper telemetry — spans, histograms, SLOs and a Prometheus exposition.

skills.name: Ask the hive
skills.description: Send a question to the distributed AI network. The hive routes it to whichever bee can answer best — a local model on a volunteer machine, a peer hive, or a cloud model.
examples: Summarise the tradeoffs of leases versus locks in a job queue.
What is the capital of Bhutan?

skills.name: Use the hive toolkit
skills.description: The twelve tools every bee carries: web search, calculator, clock, timezones, text parsing, translation, memory, file read, and more — all behind the same policy gate.
examples: What time is it in Karachi right now?

skills.name: Coder bees
skills.description: Hand a repository and a task to a coder bee: it clones to a scratch worktree, runs OpenCode headless, and returns a patch with a summary.
examples: Add a --json flag to the parser and return the patch.

skills.name: Inspect the network
skills.description: The live roster: which bees are online, what they can do, how fast they are, and how busy the hive is right now.
examples: Which bee is the fastest right now?

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.description: Bearer <hivv api key>. Absent → anonymous visitor tier (still rate-limited and still policy-gated).
